title: Meet new friends!
paragraphs: My name is Aizhan Bekova. I am 18 years old and I am from Aktobe, Kazakhstan. This year I am a first-year student at West Kazakhstan University named after Makhambет Utemisov (WKU) in Uralsk. It is a big and modern university with more than 8,000 students. University life is new and very exciting for me!

My student ID number is 22-101-06. My group is called Group 101. There are 20 students in our group — 12 girls and 8 boys. We are all first-year students and we are from different cities of Kazakhstan. My group is friendly, hardworking, and very motivated. Our classroom is Room 312 on the third floor of the main building.

My English teacher's name is Ms. Aigerim Nurova. She is 34 years old and she is from Almaty. She is an experienced, strict, and very patient teacher. Ms. Aigerim has a Master's degree in Linguistics. Her lessons are always interesting, interactive, and fun. We speak, read, write, and listen every class. She always says: "English is your passport to the world. Open it!"

My best friend at university is Dias Serik. He is 19 years old. Dias is tall, funny, intelligent, and very smart. He is also a student in Group 101 — we are classmates! Dias is from Shymkent, in southern Kazakhstan. His dream is to become a software engineer at a big technology company. He is very passionate about computers, programming, and mathematics.

My other classmates are also very interesting people. Zarina is from Almaty and she is a dancer. Bekzat is from Kyzylorda and he is a football player. Ainur is from Nur-Sultan and she is an artist. We are all different, but we are all friends. Our group is like a big family!

Our weekly timetable is very busy. Classes start at 8:30 am every day and finish at 3:30 pm. We have six subjects this semester: English, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, History of Kazakhstan, and Physical Education. My favourite subjects are English and Computer Science — they are very important for my future career in IT. Mathematics is difficult for me, but I study hard every evening.

The WKU campus is big and beautiful. There are five academic buildings, a modern sports centre, a student dormitory for 2,000 students, and a large park. The central library has more than 500,000 books and is open from 8 am to 8 pm every day, Monday to Saturday. There is also a cafeteria, a medical centre, and many student clubs — music, drama, science, and sports.

I am very happy and proud to be a WKU student! University is an amazing opportunity to learn, to grow, and to make new friends from all over Kazakhstan. My main goal this year is to improve my English, to pass all my exams successfully, and to graduate with honours in four years. I am ready for this exciting challenge. Let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Hi! My name is Aizhan. What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Hello! I am Dias. Nice to meet you, Aizhan!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too! Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: I am from Shymkent. And you?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: I am from Aktobe. How old are you, Dias?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: I am 19 years old. Are you also a first-year student?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes, I am! I am in Group 101. What about you?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Really? I am in Group 101 too! We are classmates!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: That is great! What is your favourite subject?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Computer Science. It is very interesting! And yours?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: English, of course! Ms. Aigerim is an amazing teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: I agree. She is very patient and her lessons are fun!

vocab.definition: a place of higher education with many subjects

vocab.definition: a person whose job is to teach students
vocab.example: My teacher is experienced and very kind.

vocab.definition: a student in the same class or group as you
vocab.example: Dias is my classmate and best friend.

vocab.definition: kind and pleasant to other people
vocab.example: My group is friendly and motivated.

vocab.definition: able to wait calmly without complaining
vocab.example: Ms. Aigerim is very patient with students.

vocab.definition: an area of knowledge studied at school or university
vocab.example: My favourite subject is English.

vocab.definition: a job or profession you do for a long time
vocab.example: English is important for my career in IT.

vocab.definition: always putting a lot of effort into work

vocab.definition: making you feel enthusiastic and interested
vocab.example: University life is new and very exciting!

vocab.definition: a plan showing the times of lessons or events
vocab.example: My timetable has six subjects this semester.

vocab.definition: the area of land with all university buildings
vocab.example: The WKU campus is big and beautiful.

vocab.definition: a building where students live

vocab.definition: enthusiastic and determined to achieve something

vocab.definition: a chance to do something positive

vocab.definition: speaking a language smoothly and naturally
vocab.example: My goal is to speak English fluently.

vocab.definition: having a very strong interest or enthusiasm

grammarNote: Глагол "to be" — это первый и самый важный глагол английского языка. Он используется для описания КТО ты есть, КАКОЙ ты есть, ОТКУДА ты, ГДЕ ты находишься. Без него невозможно построить ни одно базовое предложение на английском.

rows.example: I'm not from Almaty. I'm from Aktobe.
She isn't a math teacher. She's an English teacher.
They aren't in Group 102. They're in Group 101.
Yes, you are. / No, you aren't.
Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
It is on the second floor.
My subjects are English and Math.

grammarTip:
Краткие формы звучат естественно: I'm · He's · She's · It's · We're · You're · They're

Нельзя: I am not → I amn't (ОШИБКА!) · Правильно: I'm not
Можно: He is not → He isn't · She is not → She's not (оба варианта верны!)

Golden rule: Always use contractions when speaking English!
